notes: Vinyl Widget Style, Resizable AURIX Now Playing Widget & Refreshed Settings (v2.3.1): Added the tactile 'Vinyl' style (cream paper #EFE6D6 with horizontal fibers & spinning half-visible vinyl disc) across all classic widgets, introduced the new resizable 'AURIX Now Playing' widget supporting 3 responsive sizes (Compact 4x1, Player 4x2, Lyrics 4x2+) and 10 WCAG 4.5:1 verified styles (Aura, Ring, Type, Frost, Light, Night, Vinyl, Pixel, Paper, Float) with optional Material You Light/Paper theming and zero background polling when paused or screen off, plus replaced Settings > Widgets with a unified interactive preview & toggle studio

5 Glass Widget Styles & Per-Widget Configurator (v2.3.0): Redesigned AURIX Music (4x2), AURIX Lyrics (4x2), AURIX Cover (2x2), and AURIX Mini (2x2) widgets with 5 distinct glass styles (Frost Pill, Orb, Smoked Neon, Light Frost, Poster Glass), automatic WCAG 4.5:1 cover-luminance contrast, independent per-widget style persistence by appWidgetId, instant setup & long-press Reconfigure picker with live previews and optional 'Apply to all widgets', plus real widget picker previews across Android 12–15+

Redesigned Widgets, Real Picker Previews & Standby Overhaul (v2.2.0): Redesigned AURIX Music (4x2) and AURIX Lyrics (4x2) home screen widgets plus new AURIX Cover (2x2) and AURIX Mini (2x2) widgets with Glass, Color, and Mono styles in Settings, extracted ambient album glow, 24% rounded cover art, real static picker previews (Android 12–15+), and refreshed Standby Mode with Mint default mood and Split/Poster/Lyrics layouts

Proportional Widget Lyrics & Reliable Release Verification (v2.1.6): Calibrated Home Screen Lyrics widget text sizes and launcher column widths for balanced 1:1 proportions across Small, Wide, and Large widgets (plus live preview); fixed OTA release APK SHA-256 verification against GitHub Release checksum assets so updates download and verify cleanly

Bundled Full-Unicode Khmer Fonts & Redesigned Glass Widgets (v2.1.5): Replaced missing-glyph placeholder fonts with real full-Unicode Khmer & Latin .ttf fonts (Dangrek for titles, Kantumruy Pro, Koulen, Noto Sans Khmer for lyrics & UI, Outfit & Inter for English) across the entire app and all Home Screen widgets; fixed Khmer accent/header line-height clipping; redesigned Music & Lyrics Home Screen widgets with full-width header/footer, exact 1:1 text alignment matching the accent bar, tinted aurora glass pills, and cosmic midnight colors

Standby Bedside & Charging Screen + Clean Bilingual Update Error Handling (v2.1.4): Redesigned Standby Mode with 10 clock styles (Thin, Bold, Minecraft 5x7 pixel blocks, LED Dots, Flip Cards, Neon Orbitron, Serif Playfair, Round Fredoka gradient, Stack, Outline) & 12h/24h toggle, 5 color moods (Auto cover palette lerp, Lo-fi, Sunset, Mint, Mono) with drifting radial blobs, 3D Gyro Parallax (up to 14° tilt with moving glare & auto-recentering neutral point), Khmer date + mood + battery % chips, 17-segment progress bar, burn-in pixel drift & 2-minute auto-dim, plus localized EN/KM APK update download error messages with a 30-second Retry countdown when a new release is still building (HTTP 404)

Khmer Lyrics Font Picker, Dangrek Titles, Active-Only Lyric Animation & Restored Home Carousels (v2.1.3): Restored all Home Screen and Music Insights song carousels by default; refined the Home Screen Lyrics widget layout so the accent bar aligns cleanly beside the active lyric line without overlapping the side frame; restricted lyric transitions so only the currently displayed lyric line animates while upcoming lyrics remain static across widgets, in-app lyrics, and Standby Desk Clock; added a Khmer Lyrics Font selector in Settings > Lyrics (Kantumruy Pro, Koulen, Noto Sans Khmer) plus Dangrek for Khmer song titles with equalized visual glyph height when English and Khmer appear together

Clean Now Playing Lyrics View & Collapsed-By-Default Sections (v2.1.2): Cleaned up the Now Playing top header and Lyrics reading view by moving Standby Desk Clock, Orbi Companion, and Edit Lyrics into the 3-dots Song Details menu (⋮) and keeping only the minimal Share button on the Lyrics screen

Modified Official Orbi Logo Companion, Beat-Reactive Ring & Shareable Sticker Card (v2.1.1): Orbi Mini-Companion now renders AURIX's official tilted planet & 3D split orbit ring logo modified with reactive mood accessories (Lo-fi headphones, Phonk cyber shades, Late-Night sleepy moon, Romantic heart glow, Party star spark) and live beat-reactive ring pulsing; synced 6 unlockable themes with the 5 official Orbi App Icons (Classic, Midnight, Ember, AMOLED, Pearl) + Prismatic with 1-tap 'Apply as App Icon'; added interactive Mood Sticker preview chips, mini Orbi companion badge in Standby Desk Clock, and a shareable Orbi Mood & Music DNA Sticker Card PNG export

Orbi Companion, Standby Desk Clock & Cover Blur Studio (v2.1.0): Added Interactive Orbi Mini-Companion in Home header & Music Insights that reacts to your listening mood and unlocks 6 Orbi themes from real listening milestones; added Full-Screen OLED Standby Desk Clock Player with giant clock, real battery/charging pill, spinning vinyl or clean cover art, live synced lyrics & subtle visualizer; upgraded Edit Album Cover with Cover Blur Studio (6 palettes, blurred artwork backdrop, Minimal/Editorial/Monogram typography with Khmer font support) and 1-tap Auto 2×2 collage

Widget Photo Picker, Smooth Widget Animations & Clean Lyrics UI (v2.0.4): Fixed Widget Customizer Photo Picker on HEIC/AVIF and single-use gallery streams (single-read temp file + ImageDecoder + automatic GetContent fallback), fixed Home Screen Lyrics widget line transition animations by keeping composite & Khmer bitmaps well below the 1 MB Binder IPC limit (RGB_565 + self-relative slide transitions), removed the floating circle overlay from the Lyrics screen for an uncluttered reading view, and cleaned up the TAP Sync button styling in the Custom Lyrics Editor

Widget Customizer & Live Settings Preview (v2.0.3): Added Settings > Widgets > Customize widget with live 2:1 preview, 9 Frame styles, 5 Backgrounds, Blur & Darkness sliders, and fixed 2:1 Background Cropper

Developer Mode & Offline Custom Lyrics Editor (v2.0.2): Tap Build number 7 times in Settings > About to unlock Developer mode with Write & TAP Sync editor, .lrc/.txt import/export, and Room offline priority over LRCLIB
